name: Earth wall 4x4x0.8 (concave bay)
collider: mesh (or box 4 x 0.8 x 4 m centred at y=0, z=2)

joins.grid: wall centre line on y = 0, room (front) side = -Y; 4.0 m module, pivot = bottom centre of the centre line
joins.end_profile_note: identical at both ends and shared with AN02 corner arms: 0.8 m thick at the floor, front leans 0.16 m into the room at the top (y=-0.56 at z=4), top z = 4.0 at the joins (crooked 4.0-4.25 between), back y=+0.40
joins.snap: next wall at x +/- 4.0 (same y); bend a run by rotating about a join end (gap on the outside is hidden in the earth); top joins AN03 vault feet at z = 4.0

notes: front: one big concave faceted bay with 2 strata ledges, 3 protruding strata slabs, ~150 embedded pebbles, clods, crumbling ledge slabs, erosion ribs, cracks (dark V-grooves), 5 burrow holes, root tips, hair rootlets hanging from the brow, clay drips, seed husks, and a rubble/crumb/pebble heap at the foot, thick rim pillars at the joins and a brow on top; back closed, slightly bulged; bottom flat at z=0.
